notes.title: Hotfix 1.08.01
notes.notes:
Small update to fix some quality-of-life improvements for PC controllers.

[b]PATCH[/b][list]
[*]Improved direct input controller detection. [i]This should mean issues where controllers were being picked up erroneously are reduced.[/i]
[*]Added a configuration tool option to disable direct input controllers. [i]If you’re still having issues, use this to disable legacy controller support.[/i]
[*]Added an inifile option to disable the “critical control” warnings. [i]This should aid setup in cases with unusual “joysticks”, such as headtrackers using Vjoy.[/i]
[*]Added an inifile option for scaling the FOV from its default size. Not compatible with VR mode. [i]Intended for advanced users only.[/i]
[*]Added “force freelook” inifile option which causes the freelook control to stay on continuously. [i]This should be useful for headtracking setups.[/i][/list]

notes.title: Battlezone s free Gold Edition update makes VR headsets optional
notes.notes:
Those without fancy VR future-goggles can now enjoy the neon tank-wars of Rebellion’s Battlezone. While I’d assumed that the Gold Edition update for the game would be a separate release or some manner of paid upgrade, I’m happy to be wrong here. Today, the Gold Edition rolled out as a free update to all existing players, opening the door to a whole new set of players.

(more…)

notes.title: Patch 1.08 May 1st 2018
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/nvqVoEG.jpg[/img]

[h1]Patch 1.08[/h1]

[h1]Main[/h1][list]
[*]ALL Battlezone owners will be upgraded to the GOLD edition.
[*]Battlezone Gold will include the game, Classic Mode and all released tank skins, and bobbleheads.
[*]This will mean that owners of the game will get all the DLC and play without VR FREE!
[*]VR and non-VR players can play co-op together![/list]

[h1]Updates[/h1][list]
[*]“Play Again” button added to the end of a campaign.
[*]Healing shards are now present in a Nemesis Duel.
[*]Updated Radar
[*]Improved messaging when using team lives. (Respawn progress now slows down if being healed by an ally)
[*]Updated weapon behaviours.
[*]Balanced end of level rewards.
[*]Improved AI pathfinding.
[*]Increased chance of different environments throughout a campaign.[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list]
[*]Radial Weapons no longer occluded by geometry.
[*]Combo kills now retrigger in the same level.
[*]Jets now count for combo kills.
[*]Health shards will now return more health.
[*]Hacker tank rebalanced.
[*]Various smaller balance tweaks, bug fixes and performance improvements.[/list]

[b]PC Specific[/b][list]
[*]Mouse and Keyboard support added.
[*]Text chat added.[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.07 is now live!
notes.notes:
[h1]UPDATE[/h1]

[b]We're holding onto this patch for a bit longer while we chase some gremlins. We hope to release it in the next couple of hours, but if not... check back tomorrow![/b]

[h1]Patch 1.07[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added support for direct input controllers which should include the vast majority of flight stick, HOTAS controllers and older gamepads. [i]Due to the sheer variability of these controllers, customising your controls is required before attempting to play. Note that direct input controllers aren’t currently supported in classic mode - apologies for the inconvenience but we wanted to get controller support for the main game to you as soon as possible[/i].
[*]Further improvements to voice chat quality on Steam.
[*]Further improvements to jet pathfinding.
[*]Improved UI messaging when the player is dead/being revived to discourage unnecessary use of lives. [i]We’re aware that new players aren’t always aware that campaign lives are shared and we’re hoping that this will help to discourage premature respawning[/i].
[*]Fixed a bug where artillery shells would sometimes split prematurely, causing them to spread more than intended.
[*]Tweaked artillery shell splitting. [i]This change should make artillery hit the intended target more reliably. This, coupled with the above fix, should make the higher-level artillery weapons more viable[/i].
[*]Fixed a bug where Steam achievement progress was not being updated.
[/list]
[b]A minor tweak sneaked into v1.06 hotfix 1 but didn’t make patch notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased time the respawn button must be held for while a player is being revived. [i]This is intended to discourage players from respawning while they’re being revived[/i].
[/list]
